_README.reason: CREDITS-BUNDLE-HEURISTIC-1 allowlist. check-credits-coverage.mjs's BUNDLE_FILE_RE flags any *.bundle.mjs/*.bundle.js filename as vendored third-party by convention. ACCT-INFRA-KERNELS-BUILD-SPEC.md §4.1 mandates that exact suffix, 'exactly the shipped _detmath shape', for ANY shared, inline-consumed kernel composition module, regardless of whether its contents are original or vendored — so the filename alone cannot distinguish the two. This registry is the discriminator: a *.bundle.mjs file is either covered by data/credits-registry.json (genuinely vendored) or listed here with a written reason (genuinely original, authored in-house). A file matching neither is failed by the gate. Every entry carries a mandatory `reason`; an entry without one fails the gate on that ground alone. Keys are repo-relative paths with forward slashes. `_README` is inert — it names no bundle path, so it shields nothing.

chaingraph/kernels/_ruleversion.bundle.m.reason: ACCT-RULEREG-K-1. Original-authorship effective-date / rule-version registry resolver, authored from scratch for this estate per ACCT-INFRA-KERNELS-BUILD-SPEC.md §2. No third-party source, package, or code was copied into it: the closed filer-status enum, the half-open parameter-window resolution, the ISO calendar arithmetic and the bounded in-guest slice-digest assertion are all written for this row. Its pure-JS UTF-8 encoder and SHA-256 are the estate's own validated in-house construction (ART595-ART590-UTF8-FIX-1, already shipped in art-199/200/206/210/280/584/620 and _dtree.bundle.mjs), reused rather than re-authored, and likewise not third-party. Named `_ruleversion.bundle.mjs` (not `_ruleversion.mjs`) because ACCT-INFRA-KERNELS-BUILD-SPEC.md §4.1 mandates the shipped `_detmath.bundle.mjs` shape verbatim for any shared, inline-consumed kernel bundle — the RISC0 guest provides only `_hash`, so a bundle import is unavailable in-guest and this filename convention is how the estate marks 'reuse vehicle, always inlined, never imported at runtime', independent of authorship.
